t: Magnusson 80G wood sanding roll is a durable hand-sanding abrasive solution designed for smoothing and preparing timber surfaces. Suitable for carpenters, joiners, and DIYers, the medium grit sanding roll is ideal for general trade use on plaster, painted wood, hardwood and softwood. The strong E-weight paper backing resists tearing, while the high-quality aluminium oxide grain delivers fast and consistent material removal. Features an open-coat design which reduces clogging for a cleaner finish and professional results. Measuring 115mm wide by 5m long, the sanding roll cuts easily to fit hand-sanding blocks for efficient dry sanding applications.
b: Tough Paper Backing Resists Wear & Tearing
Fits Hand Blocks with Standard 115mm Width
Reduces Clogging & Dust Accumulation with Open Coat Design
Prepares Wood Surfaces for Smooth Paint & Varnish Application
Provides Efficient Cutting Action for Trade Carpentry Tasks
Simplifies Dry Hand Sanding on Hardwood & Softwood
